title: The SPLIT layout in the renderer: graphics above, his face below, as the frozen face-with-proof lock
goal:
Round 1 (branch ve-card/ve-thu-5-split-layout) failed two acceptance commands that were the card's fault: `npx vitest run packages/contracts` matches no test file, and apps/renderer/src/engine/engine.test.ts keys a table by layout and needed a SPLIT entry it was not allowed to edit. Both are fixed in this card: the contract is tested through tests/ve-stage-spec.test.ts and engine.test.ts is writable. Do the same work again.

Krish froze the face-with-proof 9:16 lock on 3 Nov 2026 ("Looks good to me.") from the round 3 key-frame mocks (apps/renderer/src/engine/mocks/face-with-proof.tsx: FWP_SPLIT_SEAM_Y, FWP_STAGE_SCALE, FWP_SPLIT_CAPTION_ZONE, FWP_POSTER_POSITIONS; golden frames in fixtures/ve/design-lock/face-with-proof/). The real renderer has no such layout, so Thursday's cut cannot be drawn the way he approved. Add it as a layout, not per-piece code.

1. Add 'SPLIT' to VeLayoutSchema (packages/contracts/src/production-spec.ts) and to EngineBeat's layout enum (apps/renderer/src/engine/props.ts).
2. In a SPLIT beat, the canvas is two parts. Top: a cream stage, x 0 to 1080, y 0 to 760 (import the seam from the mocks file, never a second copy of the number). Bottom: the camera plate, x 0 to 1080, y 760 to 1920, object-fit cover, positioned by the beat's plate crop when it is a CSS object-position string (for example '50% 88%'), else the mocks' split default. The full-bleed plate does not show in the stage area. Other layouts are unchanged.
3. slotsFor('SPLIT', '9:16', n) gives n boxes that each fill the stage (0, 0, 1080, 760), so devices compose on the stage as on STAGE, clipped to it; the device content is scaled by FWP_STAGE_SCALE about the stage's top centre with one wrapper transform. 16:9 SPLIT is refused with a clear error (no wide lock yet).
4. The caption track sits in FWP_SPLIT_CAPTION_ZONE during SPLIT beats and in its usual zone otherwise; the logo and series tag stay in the header, unscaled.

Tests (new file apps/renderer/src/engine/layouts/split.test.ts, plus any you need in the files you may write): the schema accepts SPLIT and still refuses an unknown layout; slotsFor SPLIT boxes are inside y 0 to 760; the camera box is y 760 to 1920; a SPLIT beat's caption box lies inside FWP_SPLIT_CAPTION_ZONE and never overlaps y 1080 to 1260; non-SPLIT beats keep their current slots and caption zone (the existing tests stay green); the seam, scale and caption zone are the mocks' exported values, not new literals.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. Change no device.
